Question:
From the 8 vertices of a rectangular prism, select the 2 endpoints of an edge. Are these two points and the midpoint of the edge collinear? Answer 1 if they are collinear and 0 if they are not.

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h113_q3_question_en.svg)
Solution: The endpoints and midpoint all lie on the same edge, so the three points are collinear.
